One measured slowdown inside a native MLflow store

The MLflow 3.17.1 SDK replayed retained training measurements into a local SQLite store with eight separate runs. This report selects slow-training; its logged step is explicitly declared to count training updates. Replay does not run training again.

Throughput regression

Median step time over the last 20 points (0.01215 s/step) is 2.86x the early-run baseline (0.00425 s/step, first 20 points), derived from wall_time(train/loss).

baseline_median_s=0.00425   recent_median_s=0.01215   ratio=2.859   window=20   source=wall_time(train/loss)   unit=s/step

  • Check for a dataloader/IO bottleneck (e.g. a slow shard, network storage stall, growing prefetch queue).
  • Check for memory pressure/fragmentation causing more frequent allocator work or CPU-GPU sync.
  • Check other processes on the same GPU/host, or a thermal/power throttling event.
  • If a sequence-length or batch-size curriculum increases work per step by design, this may be expected -- not a regression.
